data.narrative:
Stark Defence is a Series A defense and security company founded by Florian Seibel, Uwe Horstmann, and Johannes Schaback. The company has raised over $100M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 2 publicly traded (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

The stage-progression method is not applicable; the reported $4.0B post-money valuation appears to be a data error, as it exceeds 20x total capital raised and fails sanity thresholds. The peer-median method is applicable and reliable. Across three same-sector, same-stage comparables, the median valuation is $400M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $1.0B (Castelion).

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, centered at $400M. This range reflects the dispersion observed in the peer set but is anchored by a single methodological pillar. Key uncertainties include capital intensity and time-to-revenue profile relative to the peer median, product differentiation within an increasingly crowded defense-tech space, and regulatory pathway clarity. Validation would benefit from revenue run-rate and customer concentration metrics not available in the current dataset.
